input: The assistant receives requests but the prompt never states whether to classify, summarize, or draft.
A meeting-note feature says only 'be helpful'; the desired output is a five-bullet action list.
A support responder uses a long persona but never defines the answer objective or refusal condition.
Priority P1 and P2 tickets overlap on impact; the direct contract fails only at that boundary.
Refund and billing categories are clear except for duplicate-charge disputes.
The sentiment rubric confuses neutral complaints with negative feedback on held-out cases.
A downstream API rejects prose because it requires three typed fields and an enum.
JSON parses, but optional keys and invalid status values still break the workflow.
The extraction task is correct semantically but field types vary between runs.
Answers require the latest approved HR policy, which is absent from the request but available in an authorized index.
Product compatibility changes weekly and an approved catalog is available for retrieval.
The team wants current legal guidance from a private repository they are not authorized to access.
A user asks for live package status available through a read-only, authorized shipping API.
The assistant needs current inventory from an approved read-only warehouse endpoint.
A prompt is expected to issue refunds through a payment API without an authorization check.
A claim review requires source selection, extraction, policy comparison, and independent validation with stage metrics.
A research report needs separate retrieval, synthesis, citation verification, and a bounded retry path.
A migration review has distinct inventory, compatibility, risk, and verifier stages with separate contracts.
Calculate tax as subtotal times the published fixed rate and round to two decimal places.
Route values above 100 to queue A and all other values to queue B.
Sort records by timestamp and remove exact duplicate IDs.
Use persona prompting to approve access even when the caller has no verified identity.
Retrieve examples from another tenant because their private cases look similar.
A one-paragraph summary works, but the proposal adds an agent planner and verifier anyway.
